source: 1309 知更鸟 trace 华彩花腔
note: Doc text: 「战斗开始时，自身行动提前25%。」 Nothing new is needed for this one: BATTLE_START fires from startBattle() AFTER the queue was initialized in the constructor (so the action bar already holds everyone and there is a wait to shorten), and ADVANCE skips a fraction of the target's REMAINING wait, defaulting to the rule's owner -- so this pulls Robin forward and leaves the other three alone. E0 value (params [0.25]); the test compares her against the same character with an emptied table, because 'a quarter of the remaining wait' is not the same number as 'a quarter of the round'.
